mentions.name: Chatty Maps
mentions.description: A group decision-making tool for choosing places, described as a Doodle for places. Users can find a place that works for everyone, create collections of places, and ask for recommendations.
mentions.problem: Finding a place that works for everyone in a group.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://chattymaps.com/

An easy way to find a place that works for everyone.   Think of it as a doodle for places.

You can also create collections of places, ask for recommendations etc.
mentions.author: realty_geek
